title: Spring bill shock at the bank

dispatch.complaint: Our electric bill nearly doubled this spring. The unit runs all day, even when it's nice out.
dispatch.economizer: Honeywell JADE W7220 retrofit, C7250A MAT + OAT sensors (referential dry bulb)
dispatch.notes: ⚠ JADE fallback behavior on MAT sensor failure is not yet verified against Honeywell 63-2700. Modeled here as: economizing disabled, damper held at minimum.

faults.description: C7250A mixed air sensor open (moisture in a cracked sensor body).

readings.txt_tstat: BAS: occupied, G on, Y1 called. Space 73°F, setpoint 72°F.
readings.txt_controller: M2: compressor 1 on, blower on. No M2 alarms.
readings.txt_look_unit: Compressor 1 running on a 58°F morning. That should be free cooling weather.
readings.txt_look_economizer: Damper at about 20%. Linkage fine. MAT sensor body cracked, beads of moisture inside. Wire run intact, no splices.
readings.txt_jade_checkout: DAMPER OPEN / CLOSE both work. Blades follow the actuator.

hints: 58°F outside, 63°F changeover. Should it be economizing?

diagnosis.label: MAT sensor (C7250A) failed open
diagnosis.feedback: OL at the leads, cracked body with moisture. JADE can't modulate without MAT, so it won't economize.

diagnosis.label: OA sensor failed
diagnosis.feedback: JADE reads 58°F OA, matching your probe.

diagnosis.label: DRYBLB SET too low
diagnosis.feedback: 63°F changeover with 58°F outside means free cooling should be available. The setpoint isn't the issue.

diagnosis.label: Actuator failed
diagnosis.feedback: Checkout drives the damper full open and closed. Actuator's fine.

diagnosis.label: M2 locking out the economizer
diagnosis.feedback: M2 has no alarms, and the JADE is the one saying ECON AVAIL NO, with a sensor alarm.

repair.label: Replace C7250A MAT sensor and confirm MA TEMP vs probe
repair.feedback: Alarm clears, JADE starts free cooling, compressor drops off.

repair.label: Replace the JADE
repair.feedback: The new JADE throws the same alarm with the same dead sensor. Callback.

repair.label: Raise DRYBLB SET to 70°F
repair.feedback: Still no MAT, still no economizing.

repair.label: Put a fixed resistor across the MAT terminals
repair.feedback: Clears the alarm, but now the JADE is modulating blind and freeze protection is gone. Callback waiting to happen.

idealPath.why: 58°F OA, compressor running. Free cooling should be carrying this.
ECON AVAIL NO, MA TEMP ---, alarm MA T SENS ERR.
Cracked sensor body with moisture. Wire run intact.

debrief: The JADE needs MAT to modulate free cooling and protect against freezing. Lose it and it falls back (verify the exact behavior in 63-2700). The tell was a compressor running on a 58°F morning. The bill was the customer's symptom; the JADE alarm was sitting there the whole time.
